commit.message:
Review the whole pull request on every agentic round

Prior findings live in a log keyed by pull request, and the current
diff's file list is still complete. A round that does not fit, or a
log line that does not parse, is an omission and cannot approve.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

Keep pull-request numbers from looking like headings

Markdownlint reads a line that starts with #646 as an ATX heading
with no space after the hash.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

Pin the round log's isolation, quoting, and caps

Another pull request's records stay out of this review, finding lines
are quoted, and a log that cannot be read is an omission. The first
turn still lists every changed file.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

Let a later round approve after the prior budget fills

A superseded round and a line that names another pull request no
longer block approval. A log write that fails after the model call
returns the review that was already paid for.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>

Pass the round log through the trace wrapper

The rebase split review_lens for spans and dropped the round-log
arguments on the way into the lens. Both paths stay.

Co-authored-by: Brandon Dees <brandondees@users.noreply.github.com>
